fusions.name: Full Weight Under Way
fusions.desc: Shoulders into the target for 15 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Slamming Off the Swell
fusions.desc: Slams the ground, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, plus 5% of its maximum health to a boss or elite. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave its target [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Berth
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Slow to Gather Way
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
